quest.title: Through the Mist, a Name Unveiled
quest.description: To prevent the attacker from causing more harm, you and Kazuha decide to investigate his identity.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x675, Mora x44000, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x10

talks.objective: Ask Ryuuji for information

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey there, we'd like to ask you a quick question.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you know if anyone around here has been looking for him? For Kaedehara Kazuha, we mean!

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Aha, so this is the renowned Mr. Kaedehara! I've heard a lot about you. It is an honor to finally meet you today.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: You are too kind. We are currently investigating an assault, and would appreciate any help you can offer.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Oh? You were targeted in an assault? Let me think... I can't seem to recall anything of immediate interest.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Mr. Kaedehara is currently the talk of the town, so there are always a lot of people looking for him.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: To be honest with you, our Detective Agency has recently been receiving many inquiries from people wishing to obtain Mr. Kaedehara's personal information.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Some of them were offering us millions of Mora just to gather the information they want. If these were more legitimate commissions, Sango would have snapped them up in an instant.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: M—Millions of Mora!? Whoa... wait, even at that price, you probably still shouldn't...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Please accept my thanks for looking out for my privacy.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Of course. No matter what, we only take on legitimate cases. We don't make our money by revealing details of other people's day-to-day life just for the sake of it.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Sorry, I got a little off topic. What I'm really trying to say is, it doesn't surprise me that a complete stranger is looking for Mr. Kaedehara.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: But I wouldn't know where to begin if we want to connect this with an assault...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Then let's put that connection aside for now. Have there been any other attacks or similar incidents recently that stand out as particularly unusual?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: The Tenryou Commission had very few leads. I thought you might have some information from different sources.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: It's true that the Commissioners aren't clued up about every little thing that goes on out in the streets. But typically, it's only the most trivial events that manage to escape their attention...

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: If anyone had been out there attacking people, that would be assault, in which case the Tenryou Commission would absolutely get involved.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Th—That does make sense...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh-oh, looks like the trail's already run cold.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I still find it difficult to believe that whoever attacked you hasn't been causing any trouble elsewhere...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Few people possess your prowess in battle. So unless you were the first person he targeted, someone is certain to have been hurt by now.

choices.text: Is this your way of giving praise?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I am well aware of your talents, there is no need to be humble around me. In fact, I'm quite relieved that you were the one he targeted.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: It would cause me great grief to see someone become critically injured or lose their life because of me.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: For the poor victim, this would be a completely senseless crime.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry, we'll find him!

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: It seems you are every bit the selfless hero they make you out to be, Mr. Kaedehara. Surely, this same concern for your fellow man is what drove you to fearlessly raise your blade against the Almighty Shogun.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: You flatter me. Truth be told, I don't know quite what came over me in that moment...

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Haha, you are much too humble. Don't worry, I completely understand your concerns. I will try my best to gather whatever leads I can for you.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Oh, actually, there was one strange incident over the last few days. It doesn't involve an attack, though.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Let me tell you about it just in case.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Sure. During times like this, the more information we have, the better.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Alright then. Recently, two people went missing from the city at around the same time.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: One of them is a pretty well-known collector, surname Nagato. The other, Amenoma Yuuya, is a samurai from the Amenoma Clan.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Amenoma... now there's a familiar name.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Right. Yuuya is the nephew of Amenoma Tougo, the owner of Amenoma Smithy.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Two grown men going missing at the same time... their cases are likely connected, but I don't know much in the way of details.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: I recalled this because Amenoma Yuuya is also an accomplished martial artist who is skilled with the blade. Perhaps he is the one you are looking for.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Understood, though it seems highly unlikely to me... I neither know this man, nor do I have any idea why he may wish to attack me.

choices.text: Let's consider this a favor for Ryuuji.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure, can't hurt! We never know what we might find out along the way.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Thank you, Ryuuji. We'll start by making some inquiries at the Amenoma Smithy.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Sounds good. All the best with your investigation. I'll get moving shortly myself.

choices.text: We'll investigate both incidents at the same time.
It was also not easy for me to fight him off.

talks.objective: Ask Amenoma Tougo for information

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: As an example, the Amenoma Art strives to emulate the abiding patience and determination of water as it turns stone to sand.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: There is nothing mystical to our work. There is only practice, day in and day out, until both body and mind have memorized the craft, turning each motion of every technique into an intrinsic part of the bladesmith's life.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: As for the art of the Kaedehara Clan... I believe it's called the "Isshin Art."

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: That's right. Isshin Art strives for complete harmony between blade and mind from the moment that forging begins.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: For only a blade thus forged can capture and convey its maker's thoughts and feelings, and eventually become an extension of its wielder's will.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Indeed. Most samurai choose their blades, but an Isshin blade chooses its owner.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: You are, without a doubt, the most worthy wielder of an Isshin blade... It gladdens my heart to see that although the Kaedehara Clan has fallen on hard times, its ideals and virtues are alive and well.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: You overestimate me. My actions are guided by my own personal sentiments, not by any noble aspirations on behalf of my clan.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: But let's get back on topic. The purpose of our visit today is to gather some information on your missing nephew.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: We hope to assist with the investigation. It may turn out that this case is connected to another we are pursuing.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Ah yes, my nephew... *sigh* I reported the case to the Tenryou Commission, but I haven't heard anything back so far.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: He didn't say a word before he left, which is very unlike him. I'm still completely at a loss on what to make of it.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: But I've done what I can so far. Worrying is futile, all I can do now is wait for the news from the Tenryou Commission.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We heard that there was a collector involved in the disappearance too. Know anything about that?

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Yes. On the morning that Yuuya went missing, he gave me a very cryptic look and said that he was going to give me a great gift.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: I believe he went to collect the item from Mr. Nagato after that. The next thing I heard was that a fire had broken out at the warehouse, and neither of them came back...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A fire!?

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Yes. Strange, isn't it? I wonder what could have caused it? Unfortunately, there was very little evidence left behind, so nobody knows what really happened...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Hmm... Do you have any thoughts on what Yuuya may have wanted to give you?

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: If I had to guess... it must have been some kind of rare weapon. Otherwise, there would have been no reason for him to get my hopes up.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: He's never been particularly interested in blade-forging, but has always had a fondness for blade-testing, and can sense even the most minute differences in blade quality.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: He is extraordinarily talented in martial arts, particularly when it comes to the art of the sword.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Truth be told, we have some information that you may find to be objectionable. The person we are looking for... he attacked this friend of mine.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Based on the evidence we have gathered so far, only Yuuya seems to match the suspect's profile.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: What? No, absolutely impossible. Yuuya is not that kind of person.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: He is humble and kind. Even his training is done with the goal of calming his mind. He has never gotten into a fight before.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Huh, is that so...

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Yes. If there's one thing I can say for certain, it's that Yuuya would never draw his blade without a very good reason.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: But with that said, it's equally out of character for him to just disappear with neither farewell nor fair warning.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: I also cannot know what course of action he might be capable of if coerced, or otherwise compelled by circumstances unbeknownst to me...

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Anyway, should you find him, please let me know as soon as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Don't worry. You have our word.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... from the sound of that, Paimon doesn't think Yuuya was the one who attacked us as well.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We still need to get the info from the Nagato family.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Yes. It sounds as if something happened when the two men met each other.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Let's pay a visit to the Nagato household.

talks.objective: Go to the Nagato household and find out what happened

dialogues.speaker: Nagato Sachiko
dialogues.text: I'm very sorry, but we cannot afford to pay what we owe right now...

dialogues.speaker: Nagato Sachiko
dialogues.text: My husband has gone missing, and I'm still trying to find him.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: No, no, you misunderstand us. We are here to help with the investigation. We'd like to ask you some questions about Mr. Nagato's disappearance, if we may.

dialogues.speaker: Nagato Sachiko
dialogues.text: Ah, I see... I thought the debt collectors had come to visit again.

dialogues.speaker: Nagato Sachiko
dialogues.text: I'm sorry you have to see me in this dreadful state... Has some new information come out? Do you know where he's gone?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I'm afraid we don't have any new information at the moment. We're still trying to find out as much as we can to inform our search.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: With this in mind, can we perhaps ask some questions about your family's current situation?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: For example, Paimon's struggling to understand why a collector would be strapped for Mora...

dialogues.speaker: Nagato Sachiko
dialogues.text: *sigh* That's a long story. Ever since I've known him, he's been an avid collector of all sorts of things...

dialogues.speaker: Nagato Sachiko
dialogues.text: He'd always get so animated when he was showing them to me... I knew nothing about the items myself, but seeing how enthusiastic and excited they made him, I was happy to believe that they were just extremely important to him.

dialogues.speaker: Nagato Sachiko
dialogues.text: Everything was fine when we first got married. But as time went by, things changed for the worse...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh-oh, what happened?

dialogues.speaker: Nagato Sachiko
dialogues.text: He lost his sense of restraint. He started buying more and more things, and even resorted to borrowing money just so he could pay for them.

dialogues.speaker: Nagato Sachiko
dialogues.text: Our expenses really spiraled out of control when he started getting interested in weapons. It was awful. There were days when he'd spend hours down at the warehouse admiring his weapons even as debt collectors were descending upon our house.

dialogues.speaker: Nagato Sachiko
dialogues.text: He wouldn't sell them, wouldn't even touch them. Just sat there staring at them, like he was in a trance.

dialogues.speaker: Nagato Sachiko
dialogues.text: I'm happy he has a hobby and I'm willing to support him, but making ends meet has to come first. I've tried talking to him about it so many times, but he never listens...

dialogues.speaker: Nagato Sachiko
dialogues.text: On the last day that I saw him, I gave him an ultimatum... I said, if he refused to sell his collectibles and pay off his debts, I would divorce him and take the children with me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa...!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: And that led to an argument...

dialogues.speaker: Nagato Sachiko
dialogues.text: Actually, it didn't. Generally, he's a quiet man who likes to go with the flow. On most things, he leaves the decision-making to me.

dialogues.speaker: Nagato Sachiko
dialogues.text: You must understand, I never would have dreamed of threatening him with divorce if the debts hadn't pushed our family to the brink...

dialogues.speaker: Nagato Sachiko
dialogues.text: After I said those words, he froze, and was silent for a long time. When he finally spoke, he awkwardly mumbled that he would pick out a few items to sell.

dialogues.speaker: Nagato Sachiko
dialogues.text: His voice was so meek and pitiful that I felt an urge to take everything back. But then what? If I didn't draw the line, what would happen to our family?

choices.text: You did the right thing.

response.speaker: Nagato Sachiko
response.text: Had I not indulged his bad habits, we would not have found ourselves in such a predicament.

response.speaker: Nagato Sachiko
response.text: And I also don't know if he had actually come to his senses, or if he was simply angry with me...

response.speaker: Nagato Sachiko
response.text: The next thing I heard was that our warehouse had caught fire, and both he and the buyer had gone missing.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I see. I understand.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Amenoma Yuuya came to purchase a weapon from Mr. Nagato. During the sale, a fire broke out at the warehouse, and both men disappeared.

response.speaker: Nagato Sachiko
response.text: At first, I assumed they must have gotten into an argument over the price...

response.speaker: Nagato Sachiko
response.text: But my husband has never been one to negotiate. He never even haggles when he's out buying groceries, so it's hard to imagine him getting into a fierce argument.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... maybe he was feeling the pressure from the debts?

response.speaker: Nagato Sachiko
response.text: I don't know. He just disappeared after the warehouse burned down.

response.speaker: Nagato Sachiko
response.text: Perhaps he's too afraid to come home now that all his collectibles have been lost in the fire, and he's got no way to pay off our debts.

response.speaker: Nagato Sachiko
response.text: *sigh* Even though I'm still a little mad at him, we're a family, and I want us to face our family's crisis together.

response.speaker: Nagato Sachiko
response.text: As long as he's willing to turn over a new leaf, I know we can work things out...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Please don't get upset. There could be more to this situation than meets the eye.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: If collecting things is a habit that Mr. Nagato has had his whole life, it is quite unusual for this habit to change so drastically over a short period.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: But the information we gathered from the other side suggests Amenoma Yuuya is also a mild-mannered man who would not be likely to start an argument.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Hmm... this situation is getting a little confusing.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "A little confusing"? More like completely mystifying.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Let's try a change of scenery, and see if we can piece together what we've learned.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Rest assured, we'll notify you if we find anything.

response.speaker: Nagato Sachiko
response.text: Ah, thank you so much. I just want him to come home...

choices.text: It's important to set boundaries.

talks.objective: Go over what you know with Kazuha
Go over what you know with Kazuha

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Based on the information we've gathered so far, I can only surmise that the sales meeting between the two men was somehow the catalyst for their disappearance.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: The fire at the warehouse likely played a part in how the situation unfolded, though its exact role is a mystery.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: ...Do you have any thoughts?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Um, well... Paimon was thinking that maybe someone accidentally knocked over an oil lamp, and um...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nope, never mind, Paimon's brain needs to rest for a while. Over to you!

choices.text: They must have had an argument during the sale.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: That is the most likely conclusion based on everything we know. What started as a disagreement over the price escalated and ultimately turned into a tragedy.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: However, in this case, only one of the parties would have started the fire. That would make the other party innocent, and they would have no reason to hide themselves from the public.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: If this is indeed what happened, and the innocent man hasn't come forward yet, then it suggests they may have already lost their life.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: One fact that I keep coming back to is that Amenoma Yuuya is polite and well-mannered, while Mr. Nagato is introverted and passive. Neither seems like the type of person who is inclined towards initiating conflict.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Mr. Nagato, being heavily in debt, is also the only one of them with a potential motive to disappear after the fire.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: The more I ponder it, the more puzzling it becomes... just what could have happened there?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: This also doesn't seem connected to the case of the attacker.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Right. Although the time frame seems to broadly match, no other details that we've learned seem to link the two events together.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Amenoma Yuuya lacks a key distinguishing feature of the attacker — namely, that he is principally a practitioner of the blade-testing techniques of Amenoma Art, not those of the combat-oriented Isshin Art.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Darn, we thought we could get two birds with one stone here, but at this rate it's starting to look like a wild goose chase...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Hmm...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Let's keep going, since we've come this far.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: If we can solve the case, both Mr. Amenoma and Mrs. Nagato will be able to get some closure.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, but where should we go now?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Let's head out of the city and check out the warehouse. There's still a chance we may be able to find some shreds of evidence.

choices.text: Perhaps the fire was deliberately used to hide the truth.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: An interesting explanation. I was also considering this possibility.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Amenoma Yuuya is an expert on swords. He could have noticed some problematic details about Mr. Nagato's collectibles.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Maybe he recognized a blade as a fake, or a well-known stolen item. Either way, after arguing about it, the two men agreed to hide the truth of this matter.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: They thought a fire would destroy everything, but then the Tenryou Commission began investigating and uncovered some incriminating details, so they fled to protect their secrets...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: But it's a far-fetched theory... I can't imagine how they would have been able to reach an agreement.

choices.text: We are still missing crucial information.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Right, I very much agree with you. It seems highly likely that we're missing a piece of the puzzle...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Working off what we know so far, there are too many things that don't add up.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: The chances are that there are still some clues left for us to discover.

talks.objective: Go to the warehouse where the fire broke out
Go to the warehouse where the fire broke out

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Wait.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I hear something ominous in the wind.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohh, this must be another one of those sounds that only you can hear.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: As sketchy as that whole thing seems, you did put it to good use when we were chasing down that Vision thief at Beidou's tournament, so...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I knew we could count on you.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Hmm, now I'm picking up a strong scent in addition to the sound. It's right around here somewhere...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But there's nothing here.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: It's gone now. But I can still sense the direction it left in.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: It felt very much like that ancient presence in Inazuma... the remnants of the Tatarigami.

choices.text: Tatarigami...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Indeed. But this unexpected spring of inauspicious energy may prove to be of benefit to our investigation.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: We should remain vigilant, and approach slowly.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, so it's an underground warehouse...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: The force is definitely coming from down below.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: The source of the Tatarigami energy has long since left this place, but the residue it left behind still hasn't dissipated completely.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Judging from the concentration... I would have to conclude that the Tatarigami source resided here for a very long time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mrs. Nagato said her husband used to hang around the warehouse by himself a lot.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: It could well be that he was already under the influence of Tatarigami energy at that time.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Surely someone would have noticed?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: From what I've been told... Tatarigami does not turn all upon whom it preys into violent monsters.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: But most will develop a stubborn streak upon being exposed to the Tatarigami's unfulfilled will. Their interests become fanatical obsessions.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Mr. Nagato had an interest in collecting to begin with. The influence of Tatarigami could explain why he became an obsessive hoarder, amassing more and more possessions even as he put himself in grave debt.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um... so what should we do now? Go down and take a look?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Step back. I'll open the door and take a look inside.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's dangerous.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: If we don't open this door, we can move no closer to the truth.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: You needn't worry. Both of us have faced far greater dangers than this. Relatively speaking, the risk here is trivial.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Ah... hmm...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's down there?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Everything's buried in debris. I can't see anything.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: It looks like the fire caused a cave-in, reducing the entire warehouse to rubble.

choices.text: So in the end, it was just a scare.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That was too scary! Paimon was so sure that the warehouse bogeyman was about to jump out at us...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: All we can do now is keep searching in the direction that the Tatarigami energy's source left this place.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Two ordinary humans, entangled with the Tatarigami... I fear much misfortune has already befallen them.

choices.text: Let's hurry.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Yes, let's go. If nothing else, it's vital that we find out where this Tatarigami energy is coming from.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Quiet your mind and focus on what you sense around you... perhaps you, too, will perceive its ominous presence in the wind.

choices.text: We cannot afford to delay any longer.
I'm not sure if that's a good or bad thing...
That's one thing I didn't expect to encounter here.

Follow the scent and look for clues
Follow the scent and look for clues

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: From this point, the trail appears to split into two.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: The main source of the Tatarigami energy continued on into the distance. But a small portion remained here, and seems to be dissipating slowly.

choices.text: Two parts, so would that correspond to...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Quite possibly. Let's search the area.

choices.text: ...Mr. Nagato and Amenoma Yuuya?

talks.objective: Follow the scent and look for clues
Follow the scent and look for clues
Defeat the hilichurls

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Growing up, Yuuya never caused anyone any trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: *sigh* What could have happened to him...

talks.objective: Talk to Kazuha
Keep following the scent and looking for clues

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I—It's...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Agh! Look at this red stuff... Wh—What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: By the looks of it, a letter, written on a piece of torn clothing. The ink is bone-dry... it must have been written quite some time ago.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Well, let's take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: According to this letter, a conflict arose because Amenoma Yuuya wanted to seize a blade belonging to Mr. Nagato.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Yuuya started the fire that destroyed the warehouse, and wounded Mr. Nagato in the fight. Mr. Nagato kept chase as long as he could, eventually stopping here to write this letter when his strength gave out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... where is he...?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: He was not only mortally wounded, but also under the heavy influence of Tatarigami. Add to that the fact that its aura seems to have attracted a horde of monsters, and... I'm afraid he may no longer be with us.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Whatever traces there may have been of his fate beyond after this point, they've since been disturbed by the hilichurls. There's nothing more for us to find here.

choices.text: Let's ask the Tenryou Commission to do a thorough search later.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Yes, right now, we need to uncover some more important truths.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: If Amenoma Yuuya is attacking other people indiscriminately, then the longer we take to find him, the more people risk meeting the same tragic end.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right, so let's get moving!

choices.text: How did it come to this...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I wouldn't be surprised if he, too, fell prey to the influence of the Tatarigami.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: For a practitioner of the martial arts, the easiest desire to inflame would be their pursuit of further power and skill.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: All the clues that at first seemed disparate and disconnected... it seems that now we know the thread that runs between them.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I have a hypothesis that, if it's correct, not only explains the series of events leading to the two men's disappearance, but also zeroes in on the attacker's identity.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Wait, you've figured it out? So these two cases are connected after all?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I believe so... but it's something of an outlandish idea. I will only be able to confirm my suspicions once we've met him in person.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: On with the search. We must stay vigilant. At any point now, we may find ourselves in danger.

choices.text: It's not in his nature.
There are more important things right now.

talks.objective: Keep following the scent and looking for clues
Keep following the scent and looking for clues
Keep following the scent and looking for clues

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Please, be careful during your investigation.

talks.objective: Keep following the scent and looking for clues
Keep following the scent and looking for clues

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: He seems to have stayed here for a long time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why here? Is there anything special about this place?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I'm not sure... but on closer examination, I sense that the aura may have lingered here at several different points in time...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Show yourself! It's no use hiding anymore!
Hmph.
Kaedehara Kazuha... it's you, at last.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aha! So it IS the same guy from before!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's your problem, huh? What could you possibly have against Kazuha!?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Indeed, there should be no enmity between us... if it is Amenoma Yuuya that stands before us.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: But what if instead of facing Amenoma Yuuya... we are in fact facing the blade in his hand?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...The blade?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now that you mention it, it is giving off a strange light...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, whoa, surely you don't mean... Are you serious!?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Tatarigami energy often lodges itself within physical objects, then works to subtly affect any living organisms in its vicinity.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: The blade has resided in Mr. Nagato's warehouse for many years, affecting his state of mind, and more recently using the sale as a means to affect...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Or rather, as a means to occupy Amenoma Yuuya's body.
Hmph. You're sharper than I thought. You've already deduced the truth of the matter.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: Many, many years ago, I was forged by a famed bladesmith of the Isshin tradition. I was his pride and joy, in me, he placed all his hopes and dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: As a descendant of the Kaedehara Clan, you should be able to guess our greatest regret.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I presume it has something to do with the Raiden Gokaden.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: Indeed. At that point in time, he failed to live up to the Raiden Shogun's expectations. In the end, all he could do was to flee the nation by sea, on a ship bound for Snezhnaya.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: He was a bladesmith of great renown, a master of his craft! There was nothing that he could not accomplish! All he needed was more time, and a little faith.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: And sure enough, in the end, he achieved what he had set out to do. All of his life's work — his wisdom, his skill — it culminated in his creation of me.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: He not only bestowed upon me the greatest of strength, but also endowed me with a consciousness of my own...

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: In her conceit, the Raiden Shogun lost not only the single most perfect blade in the entire world, but also an irreplaceable achievement in the art of blade-forging!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... swords can become conscious? And... control people!?

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: The people of the time in which I was born never believed I had that kind of power. They saw me as a mere blade — a sharp and well-crafted one, but in all other respects an ordinary weapon. Hmph, but that gave me the opportunity to take action.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: After the death of my creator, I decided to leave Snezhnaya, and began my long quest to return to the distant land of Inazuma. Moving from one person to the next, I controlled the minds of countless hosts along the way, each bringing me one step closer to my ancestral home.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: I seek but one thing: to face the full force of the Raiden Shogun's blade, and prove my power, the might of Isshin Art!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: So Amenoma Yuuya was not your first victim.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Tell me, what happens to those you've possessed when you've finished using them?

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: My hosts? Who cares what happens to them. They are but tools that serve my mission.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: When they got tired, or injured, or unusable, I hopped to the next one in line. All I needed them for was to take me back to Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're awful!

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: After I returned to Inazuma, I decided to bide my time in Nagato's warehouse, until Amenoma Yuuya handed himself over to me on a silver platter.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: At long last, I am approaching my journey's destination. By Amenoma Yuuya's body I have found you, and by your hand I shall defeat the Raiden Shogun!

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: Kaedehara Kazuha, you stood against the Raiden Shogun's Musou no Hitotachi. There can be no other to serve as my host for what is to come.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: Now, give your body over to me!

talks.objective: Defeat the attacker

dialogues.speaker: Nagato Sachiko
dialogues.text: Thank you for your help. The longer this drags on, the worse things at home will get...

talks.objective: Talk to Kazuha
Talk to Kazuha

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: Do not stand in my way, or I will strike you down too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Your bluff's fooling no one. You've lost!

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: Lost? I can never lose. It is this body that has reached its limit, nothing more.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: Even if you defeat me here, the one who falls will not be me, but this man.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: He is but a puppet that can be replaced. I can take a new vessel at will.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then we will smash you into pieces.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: The end result is the same! I will end this wretch's life before you can lift a finger.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: And even if I were to lose my physical form, it is but a small setback. My consciousness shall endure.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: By any means necessary and any medium available, I shall return and fulfill my destiny!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Your fighting style... it is indeed the forms of Isshin Art.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: But from your movements, I sense only hatred and arrogance, as well as a thinly veiled mania and despair.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? You can tell all that just from his moves?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: As I've mentioned before, the forms of Isshin Art convey the user's thoughts and feelings.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Since the blade is currently possessing Amenoma Yuuya's body, its movements express the innermost thoughts of the blade.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: If you ask me, the mania is probably due to your desperate, single-minded ambition. You believe I am your only hope.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: Are you trying to claim that I am helpless without you?

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: On his deathbed, he passed to me all of Isshin Art's secrets. The little that you know barely scratches the surface.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: In that regard, why would I ever need your help?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Because all of that is in the past.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I've been wondering why you've not caused more trouble in all the years that you've been in Inazuma, if you are indeed a cursed blade that can possess its owner.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Now that I've seen inside your mind, everything finally makes sense. You weren't biding your time... you were trapped.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: Hmph...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: After all the time that's passed, you have grown weak, to the point that you are now unable to acquire a new host without making physical contact.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, that's right, Paimon remembers now! Mr. Nagato had a habit of never touching his collectibles!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Only when Mr. Nagato witnessed his wife's distress and decided to sell his collectibles did you finally have an opportunity to reach out to Amenoma Yuuya and make your escape.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: Hmph, what of it!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Well, that brings me to my second point. There's a despair in you that is so strong, it threatens to overwhelm you.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: You were determined to fulfill your maker's ambition, whatever the cost. But this ambition is too grand, and too heavy for you to bear. Each step you have taken has come at a great cost.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I think you realized your limitations long ago. The more you clenched your teeth and pressed forward, the greater your fear of losing everything you had achieved grew, and the more you wished to run from the truth.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: But the way I see it... what began as an ambition has long since become a delusional fantasy.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: What would you know about any of this? I'm just one step away from achieving my goal!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: You returned to Inazuma to prove the unparalleled brilliance of Isshin Art. But to make this arduous journey, you committed countless atrocities, and showed a blatant disregard for human life.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Even if you were to sever that divine light... is this truly the outcome that your maker would have desired?

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: You...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Sure, you inherited the secrets of Isshin Art, but even as you made your journey to honor this legacy, you treated the ones who wielded you as mere tools to do your bidding.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: How could you possibly unleash the full potential of Isshin Art, when you act in perfect discordance with the principle of harmony between a blade and its bearer?

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: Silence, you blabbering fool...

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: I must achieve my goal. This was his life's dream, and the very purpose for which I was brought into being.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: I will concede that you are most perceptive. You see my predicament clearly... but you also underestimate my resolve.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: And you should face reality.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: Easy for you to say! Facing reality offers me nothing!

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: I have no need of anything that would stand in my way. Not hesitation, not self-reflection, and certainly not your so-called reality!

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: It is pointless to argue further, descendant of the Kaedehara Clan. If you wish to save this man, then offer me your body in exchange.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: How stubbornly you stick to your wayward path...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I do not believe for a second that you can challenge the Almighty Shogun in your current state. So let us make a bet, and I will put your strength to the test.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? Surely you're not planning to agree to his demands...

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: Very well, then find yourself some enemies with whom you wish to cross blades. A taste of my power will more than convince you.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: Once we have dealt with them, we shall proceed to Tenshukaku.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: And as for your end of the bargain, if you lose, you must release Amenoma Yuuya from your control.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: I accept.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't do this, Kazuha!

choices.text: This is a risky strategy.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: This is the only way to save Amenoma Yuuya. If we don't do this, he'll forever be the blade's puppet.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: The cursed blade's strength is currently very weak, and I sense he's hesitating. This suggests his heart is still not completely devoid of honor.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: The power of the Tatarigami lies in intensifying existing obsessions. This is the reason Mr. Nagato and Amenoma Yuuya fell prey to it. Since I don't have any similar kinds of obsessions, I should be able to put up some resistance for a while.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But, even so...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Even if things take a turn for the worse, I still have you both here with me.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: We have a chance here to save an innocent victim. I am willing to accept the risks entailed.

choices.text: Alright, fine.

response.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
response.text: Your disdain for me betrays your woeful ignorance. I agreed to this bet because there are things I wish to learn, too.

response.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
response.text: Now, take me in your hand.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Ugh!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Kazuha!

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I... I'm okay...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I felt a little dizzy at first, but only for a moment.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: It's alright. So far, this was as I expected.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: If something feels off, let me know immediately.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I will. Thank you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What should we do next? Have you got a plan, Kazuha?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: We find some enemies.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Although this blade has endured much turmoil, it probably hasn't experienced many real fights.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: If a blade built for Isshin Art cannot enter a state of harmony between blade and bearer, it cannot unleash its true power.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: If he wants to avoid reality, then we need to fight until he has no choice but to face it. He shouldn't last long in an intense combat situation.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait a minute... Paimon remembers hearing about something from the Adventurers' Guild...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Since the Takatsukasa Clan abandoned that secret base, it's been held by ronin ever since.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That should fit the bill.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Ah, alright. Please lead the way.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What about Amenoma Yuuya? What should we do with him?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: The blade says he'll let Amenoma Yuuya trail us silently. Although he hasn't regained his own consciousness yet, he is not in any immediate danger.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are we sure this is a good idea? It's a pretty treacherous journey...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay fine... just be careful.

choices.text: It's not like I can stop you.
You're dealing with a cursed blade that can possess people.

talks.objective: Additional

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Ah, if it isn't Kaedehara Kazuha! What brings you here today?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? You two know each other?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Yes. The Kaedehara and Amenoma Clans were both members of the Raiden Gokaden. Historically, there have always been deep links between the two clans.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: After I returned to Inazuma, I visited Mr. Amenoma to pay my respects.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "Raiden Gokaden"?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Ah, let me quickly explain. The Raiden Gokaden was the collective term for the five most acclaimed bladesmithing arts in Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: The techniques of blade-making were personally bequeathed to the Raiden Gokaden by the Almighty Shogun, and over time, further honed and enhanced by the most talented craftsmen.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, a series of events led to the gradual decline of many clans in the bladesmithing trade. Today, only the Amenoma Clan has kept its art alive.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So sad...

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: *sigh* It is a great pity indeed. In the old days, we each had our specialties, and just as iron sharpens iron, so too did we learn much from each other.

talks.objective: Additional

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? You two know each other?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Yes. The Kaedehara and Amenoma Clans were both members of the Raiden Gokaden. Historically, there have always been deep links between the two clans.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: After I returned to Inazuma, I visited Mr. Amenoma to pay my respects.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ah. I see.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Yes. You may recall the story of the Raiden Gokaden from the Irodori Festival.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Though all bladesmiths trace their craft back to the same source, over time, each of us has arrived at a different blade-making philosophy, spawning the development of different branches of the same art.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: As an example, the Amenoma Art strives to emulate the abiding patience and determination of water as it turns stone to sand.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: There is nothing mystical to our work. There is only practice, day in and day out, until both body and mind have memorized the craft, turning each motion of every technique into an intrinsic part of the bladesmith's life.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: As for the art of the Kaedehara Clan... I believe it's called the "Isshin Art."

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: That's right. Isshin Art strives for complete harmony between blade and mind from the moment that forging begins.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: For only a blade thus forged can capture and convey its maker's thoughts and feelings, and eventually become an extension of its wielder's will.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Indeed. Most samurai choose their blades, but an Isshin blade chooses its owner.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: You are, without a doubt, the most worthy wielder of an Isshin blade... It gladdens my heart to see that although the Kaedehara Clan has fallen on hard times, its ideals and virtues are alive and well.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: You overestimate me. My actions are guided by my own personal sentiments, not by any noble aspirations on behalf of my clan.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: But let's get back on topic. The purpose of our visit today is to gather some information on your missing nephew.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: We hope to assist with the investigation. It may turn out that this case is connected to another we are pursuing.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Ah yes, my nephew... *sigh* I reported the case to the Tenryou Commission, but I haven't heard anything back so far.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: He didn't say a word before he left, which is very unlike him. I'm still completely at a loss on what to make of it.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: But I've done what I can so far. Worrying is futile, all I can do now is wait for the news from the Tenryou Commission.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We heard that there was a collector involved in the disappearance too. Know anything about that?

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Yes. On the morning that Yuuya went missing, he gave me a very cryptic look and said that he was going to give me a great gift.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: I believe he went to collect the item from Mr. Nagato after that. The next thing I heard was that a fire had broken out at the warehouse, and neither of them came back...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A fire!?

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Yes. Strange, isn't it? I wonder what could have caused it? Unfortunately, there was very little evidence left behind, so nobody knows what really happened...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Hmm... Do you have any thoughts on what Yuuya may have wanted to give you?

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: If I had to guess... it must have been some kind of rare weapon. Otherwise, there would have been no reason for him to get my hopes up.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: He's never been particularly interested in blade-forging, but has always had a fondness for blade-testing, and can sense even the most minute differences in blade quality.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: He is extraordinarily talented in martial arts, particularly when it comes to the art of the sword.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Truth be told, we have some information that you may find to be objectionable. The person we are looking for... he attacked this friend of mine.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Based on the evidence we have gathered so far, only Yuuya seems to match the suspect's profile.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: What? No, absolutely impossible. Yuuya is not that kind of person.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: He is humble and kind. Even his training is done with the goal of calming his mind. He has never gotten into a fight before.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Huh, is that so...

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Yes. If there's one thing I can say for certain, it's that Yuuya would never draw his blade without a very good reason.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: But with that said, it's equally out of character for him to just disappear with neither farewell nor fair warning.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: I also cannot know what course of action he might be capable of if coerced, or otherwise compelled by circumstances unbeknownst to me...

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Anyway, should you find him, please let me know as soon as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Don't worry. You have our word.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... from the sound of that, Paimon doesn't think Yuuya was the one who attacked us as well.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We still need to get the info from the Nagato family.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Yes. It sounds as if something happened when the two men met each other.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Let's pay a visit to the Nagato household.

talks.objective: Additional

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, look at all those hilichurls! They're acting really strangely!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Something seems to be drawing their attention. Let's take a closer look.

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: Submit to me!

dialogues.speaker: Prized Isshin Blade
dialogues.text: We shall rewrite history!
